description: Verified totals of money obligated in the dates asked, per recipient or agency, where verified figures are available. Where they are not, it says so, gives no total, and lists the largest matching awards with their lifetime values labelled. Never present a lifetime value or a sum of them as a period total.

since.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); only rows on or after this date

until.description: ISO date; only rows on or before this date

name: award_totals
title: Award totals by recipient, ticker or agency
